description: FM3 VCO: the Surge XT four-operator FM oscillator, with two ratio modulators and a third at a fixed frequency

params.text: Sets the pitch in volts, added to the voltage at V/OCT; 0V gives middle C at 261.63Hz.
Sets how hard the first modulator drives the carrier.
Sets the frequency of the first modulator as a multiple of the carrier, up to 32, and it need not be a whole number.
Sets how hard the second modulator drives the carrier.
Sets the frequency of the second modulator as a multiple of the carrier, up to 32, and it need not be a whole number.
Sets how hard the third modulator drives the carrier.
Sets the frequency of the third modulator in hertz, from about 14Hz to 25kHz, with no relation to the played pitch.
Feeds the carrier back into itself, either way round, over 400%.
Modulation depth into pitch, in octaves per volt; at 1 the modulation input tracks 1V per octave.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.
Shifts the pitch in whole octaves, three either way.
Widens the feedback range from 100% to 400%.
Switches the feedback to the smoother vintage FM behaviour.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at 1V per octave; the PITCH knob is added to it.
A trigger resets the oscillator the way a new note does, restarting unison phases and the pitch drift.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

outputs.text: The left channel of the oscillator; with a single unison voice the same signal appears on both channels.
The right channel of the oscillator.

notes: A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: M1 Absolute — reads the first modulator ratio as a frequency in hertz rather than as a ratio to the pitch.
M2 Absolute — reads the second modulator ratio as a frequency in hertz rather than as a ratio to the pitch.
Retrigger With Phase=0 — restarts every unison voice from the same phase when the oscillator is retriggered.
Character — a submenu setting a fixed filter on the output: Warm, Neutral or Bright.
Oscillator Drift — a slider in the menu setting how much slow random pitch wander is added, as a percentage.
Output Level — a slider in the menu attenuating the oscillator's output, as a percentage.
Halfband Filter — a submenu choosing the downsampling filter used on the oversampled oscillator, from M = 6, steep to M = 1, shallow.
Apply DC Blocker — switches on the high pass that removes any DC offset from the output.
Curve Poly Channel — a submenu choosing which polyphonic channel the display draws, Ch 1 to Ch 16.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
